verdict.rationale: Kit can be driven headlessly through its V4 API. API keys are offered specifically 'for automating simple tools and integrations for your own account' [kit-docs-30], alongside bulk and async processing with callback URLs [kit-docs-23, kit-docs-35], webhooks with retries [kit-docs-21, kit-docs-40], and cursor pagination [kit-docs-34]. That makes scripted, non-interactive automation feasible, but there is no CLI, no CI-specific tooling or guidance, and the probe found no published OpenAPI spec [kit-probe-2]. Missing for 10: official CLI or CI integration (e.g., GitHub Action), documented CI/headless usage guide, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
